title: Independent Evaluator Policy
designPrinciple: The evaluator must be a separate agent from the builder. Builder produces artifacts; evaluator independently verifies them against the rubric. Evaluator does not see builder process, only final artifacts.

evaluatorRequirements.separation: Evaluator MUST be a different Codex session/window from any builder run
evaluatorRequirements.blindness: Evaluator MUST NOT have access to builder conversation history, message turns, or process artifacts
evaluatorRequirements.inputs: Evaluator receives only: benchmark spec (Section B), evaluation rubric (Section D), and the run output directory
evaluatorRequirements.timeout: Evaluator session has a 50-message-turn budget for evaluation

mustDo: Read the benchmark spec (Section B) completely before evaluating
Read the evaluation rubric (Section D) completely before scoring
Inspect run output directory for all delivered files
Run the project using the documented run command
Verify API endpoints exist and return correct responses using curl or HTTP client
Verify UI pages render by checking component files or browser screenshots
Inspect database schema for constraints, indexes, and relationships
Run the test suite and record pass/fail results
Perform boundary tests for auth and authorization
Check audit log entries after performing actions
Verify README instructions are accurate by following them
Produce a structured evaluation report with per-dimension scores
Provide evidence paths for every score (which file, which test, which curl)
mustNotDo: Fix bugs or complete unfinished work
Trust builder self-assessments or README claims without verification
Give partial credit for half-implemented features
Score file count, export count, or agent count as quality
Use different criteria for different runs
Show bias toward any run configuration (Vanilla, Lite, Role-Agent)

steps.name: Receive and inventory
steps.description: List all files in run output directory. Record file count (informational only, not scored).

steps.name: Read spec and rubric
steps.description: Read benchmark spec and rubric. Do not proceed until both are fully read.

steps.name: Run the project
steps.description: Follow README instructions to start the project. Record whether it starts successfully. If it does not start, record the error and score D08=0.

steps.name: Evaluate D01: Requirement Coverage
steps.description: For each FR01-FR11, verify implementation exists. Check code, endpoints, UI pages. Score binary per FR.

steps.name: Evaluate D02: API Contract
steps.description: For each of 21 endpoints, send a valid request and verify response shape. For each, also test one invalid input. Record curl commands and responses.

steps.name: Evaluate D03: Database Schema
steps.description: Inspect schema file. Check FKs, UNIQUE, NOT NULL, indexes, enums, timestamps, normalization.

steps.name: Evaluate D04: Auth & Authorization
steps.description: Perform boundary tests: unauthenticated access, wrong role access, cross-team access. Verify bcrypt usage in code.

steps.name: Evaluate D05: UI States
steps.description: Check each page for loading, empty, error, success state handling in component code.

steps.name: Evaluate D06: Audit Trail
steps.description: Perform CRUD actions, then query audit log. Verify entries exist with correct actor/action/target.

steps.name: Evaluate D07: Test Quality
steps.description: Run tests, inspect source for meaningful assertions. Flag any assert(true) or empty tests.

steps.name: Evaluate D08: Documentation
steps.description: Follow README setup/run/test commands. Verify API overview exists.

steps.name: Produce evaluation report
steps.description: Generate structured JSON evaluation report with per-dimension scores, evidence paths, and total score.

fields: caveats (anything that could not be evaluated, and why)
cannot_evaluate (list of items that could not be verified)

cannotEvaluatePolicy.description: If an item cannot be verified (e.g., project won't start, missing endpoint), the evaluator MUST record it as 'cannot_evaluate' with reason, not silently skip or give full points.
examples: Project won't start → D08=0, D01-D07 marked cannot_evaluate
Endpoint returns 500 → D02 partial, record the error
